item.text: {"results":[{"pair_id":"J02540","case1_error":"Adds one week's kale to two weeks' doubled asparagus and broccoli, mixing time periods.","case2_error":"Reverses the half-distance relationship, setting the first leg to 20 miles instead of 80.","reason":"Case 1 combines quantities covering different durations; case 2 reverses a stated proportional relationship.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02541","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates 35 × 0.2857 as 9.5; the exact pasta requirement is 10 pounds.","case2_error":"Returns the $80 price per pair rather than the $480 total price for six pairs.","reason":"Case 1 makes a numerical evaluation error; case 2 answers the unit-price quantity instead of the requested total.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02542","case1_error":"The leading answer marker says 40, but the derivation correctly obtains a 50 mph speed limit.","case2_error":"Counts only Jake's consumption, omitting his brother and father from the intended four-week household purchase.","reason":"Case 1 contains only an answer-marker conflict, so a shared mathematical error mechanism cannot be established.","judgment":"uncertain"},{"pair_id":"J02543","case1_error":"Counts the two mother lambs twice, adding them again despite their inclusion in the original six.","case2_error":"Provides an unsupported final 29 after the correct formula 65 − (22 + 24), whose value is 19.","reason":"Case 1 double-counts a subset; case 2 supplies an incorrect final number without showing an erroneous calculation.","judgment":"different"},{"pair_id":"J02544","case1_error":"Incorrectly evaluates the correct expression 3,000 × 8 ÷ 6 as 2,000 instead of 4,000.","case2_error":"Returns Yeon's 1,020 seeds rather than the combined 1,660 seeds of all three people.","reason":"Case 1 incorrectly evaluates a correct expression; case 2 reports one person's quantity instead of the requested combined total.","judgment":"different"}]}
